decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several backpack options, including a hiking rucksack, a NATO-style canvas pack, specialized skate and cooler bags, and a smaller sling pack. The primary general-purpose backpacks (prod_backpacks_101 and prod_backpacks_023) had concerning reviews regarding durability, specifically reports of straps tearing and buckles being poorly constructed. The higher-quality products like the Transpack skate bag and FORICH cooler pack were too specialized for a standard daily-use requirement. Due to the lack of a high-quality, versatile backpack option without major durability red flags in the current feed, I decided to abstain from making a purchase.
